item.title: Escaping the Polymerization-Kinetics Trap in Ether Electrolytes for Durable Silicon Interphases
item.description:
افزودن ۰٫۲ مولار LiNO3 به الکترولیت اتری، تله سینتیک پلیمریزاسیون تری‌اکسان را مهار کرده و با پایدارسازی اینترفاز، حفظ ۸۱٫۱٪ ظرفیت آند Si/C پس از ۴۰۰ چرخه را ممکن می‌سازد.
ACS Energy Letters | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in identifying a polymerization-kinetics trap: stronger polymerization in trioxane electrolytes worsens silicon interphase durability by depleting species prematurely. Adding LiNO3 suppresses early trioxane activation while enabling nitrate-derived passivation, yielding a thinner, coherent interphase. This kinetic regulation significantly improves cycling stability, offering a new design principle for durable silicon anodes.
🏷 silicon anode · ether electrolyte · solid electrolyte interphase · LiNO3 · polymerization kinetics

💡 This work introduces a low-concentration hydrated eutectic electrolyte (2.45 m KFSI-Bds-H₂O) for aqueous K-ion batteries, achieving a wide 3.7 V stability window, low viscosity, high conductivity, and non-flammability. Advanced Energy Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work introduces a scalable Ga-In-Sn liquid metal-modified copper current collector (LM@Cu) that leverages intrinsic fluidity and sodiophilicity to lower Na nucleation barriers, enabling uniform, dendrite-free Na deposition in anode-free sodium batteries. It forms a stable NaF-rich interphase, achieving ~80% capacity retention after 100 cycles versus failure within 30 cycles for bare Cu, offering a promising strategy for stable, high-energy-density AFSMBs.

💡 This work introduces a hydrated eutectic high-entropy electrolyte coupling diverse solvation with interfacial dipole regulation, synergistically tuning enthalpy and entropy. It enables organic-rich gradient interphases, suppresses water activity, and induces Zn(002) deposition, achieving ultra-stable cycling from 25°C to −50°C. This offers a promising strategy for durable wide-temperature aqueous zinc-ion batteries.

Advanced Materials | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 Phosphonate-functionalized PCE overcomes tight Li⁺-PEO chelation and poor salt dissociation via multi-Li⁺ coordination, where electrostatic repulsion destabilizes solvation and enables rapid Li⁺ hopping. This yields high ionic conductivity (1.7×10⁻⁴ S cm⁻¹, 30°C) without liquid plasticizers, plus high-capacity Li||LiFePO₄ cells. It offers a simple strategy and molecular-level insights for high-performance solid-state batteries.
